Subject: GCP metering delta — APAC prefixes (first pass)

Sergio / Vanessa —

I pulled the prefix-level metering export from GCP for the APAC marketplace listings and there are ~3.2k tokens of usage that didn't map to our seller mapping for Apr 1–14. Attached is a short CSV with the suspect prefixes and the raw usage id column. The gaps cluster around two project IDs that the reseller partners forwarded as newly onboarded last month.

Action I'm proposing:
- Vanessa: can you confirm whether those two project IDs were routed under the reseller entity (finance.apac@reseller.co)?
- Sergio: if confirmed, we'll need the reseller to provide invoice offsets or a credit memo and a signed evidence bundle to clear the payout hold.

I'm attaching the CSV: gcp_metering_prefix_delta_20290418.csv (summary + raw ids).

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

+1 on Marcus's findings. I cross-checked with the reseller contact (finance.apac@reseller.co) — they confirm two onboarding projects (project-a-prod and project-b-prod) were initially invoiced under their master entity but should have been attributed to Acme Cloud Labs (our end-customer). They said they're preparing a 'seller reconciliation file' and expect to send it by EOD Apr 20.

I'll ask them to include: original metering export, reseller invoice id, and a signed statement that the charges should route to Acme Cloud Labs. I'll copy back here when we receive it.

2) Signed reconciliation statement from Reseller Co confirming the re-assignment to Acme Cloud Labs (PDF).
3) Original GCP metering export lines (CSV) and the corresponding marketplace invoice ids.
